subject.title: [Bug]: Non-Anthropic models output tool calls as plain text '[tool: exec]' instead of tool_use blocks

question: How should OpenClaw handle a provider response that contains only a bare tool marker such as `[tool: exec]` without arguments or structured `toolCall` content?
rationale: Current source can safely recover serialized payloads, but marker-only output lacks executable arguments and the alternatives change provider/runtime fallback policy.

options.title: Warn and recover conservatively
options.body: Detect marker-only output, keep it out of user-visible replies where possible, and retry or fall back to a known tool-capable model without executing missing arguments.

options.title: Treat affected routes as unsupported
options.body: Warn or block MiniMax/DeepSeek-style routes for tool-enabled agents until they pass a real structured tool-call capability check.

options.title: Parse marker-only text as intent
options.body: Attempt to convert bare markers into tool intent, accepting the risk that missing arguments require additional prompting or model-specific behavior.

recommendation.title: Warn and recover conservatively
recommendation.body: Detect marker-only output, keep it out of user-visible replies where possible, and retry or fall back to a known tool-capable model without executing missing arguments.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision touches the private provider-stream promotion boundary and plugin SDK/runtime policy that recent history shows this owner maintained.
